en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a black and white photograph of a large Gothic-style cathedral with two tall spires. The postcard has handwritten text in a script that appears to be Croatian and French. The printed text includes 'Zagreb – Agram (Croatie)' and 'Prvostolna crkva – La Cathédrale,' suggesting a bilingual context. The cathedral is surrounded by trees and other historical buildings.
